race.title: Boyle Sports Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: SLANEY OPERA has made a positive start for his new trainer, scoring at Uttoxeter in October and beaten only by an improver over C&D last time, so he is taken to resume winning ways. Safe Destination returned to form when third to the selection on his reappearance and is the pick for second, ahead of Camarrate . SLANEY OPERA (IRE) SAFE DESTINATION CAMARRATE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Camarrate (9/4), Slaney Opera (11/4), Safe Destination (7/2), Peckforton Hills (5/1), Trac (10/1), Check The Score (12/1)
